chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Hamdan al-Qalansi, who said:

I said to al-'Amri: 'Has Abu Muhammad عليه السلام passed away?' So he said: 'He عليه السلام has passed away, but he عليه السلام has left behind among you one whose neck is like this,' and he indicated with his hand.

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: a title referring to the Imam عليه السلام mentioned in the report
key_terms.الْعَمْرِيِّ: al-'Amri, the person being addressed in the narration
key_terms.رَقَبَتُهُ: his neck; used here as a descriptive identifying feature
key_terms.مَضَى: passed away; departed from this world

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام and the one he left behind?
ai.summary: This report records a question to al-'Amri about the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام and his confirmation that he had indeed passed away. It also indicates that Abu Muhammad عليه السلام left behind a successor present among the people, conveyed through a physical gesture of identification.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Hamdan Al Qalansy who said,

‘I said to Al-Amry, ‘Had Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> passed away?’ So he said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> has passed away, but he<sup>asws</sup> has left behind among you the one<sup>asws</sup> whose neck is like this’, and he indicated by his hand’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Hamdan al-Qalanisi who has said the following.

“I asked al-‘Amri, “Has abu Muhammad (a.s.) passed away?” He said, “Yes, he has passed away but has left behind among you a person (the succeeding Imam) whose neck is like this. He made a sign with his hand (meaning thereby good health and beauty).”
